static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.family_status: Living with parents and younger brother
static_traits.social_status: 在新环境中交友困难;虽有父母和弟弟的支持,但难以向家人表达Loneliness与not安全感
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;既往without心理治疗经历;此前not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,配合度高,能自我Reflection并Identify automatic thoughts;Positive attitude,愿意尝试新方法;在社交话题上呈现Anxiety但能进行理性讨论

basic_info.main_problem: 我相信即使在秋季的足球中交到朋友,他们也只是因为我们必须一起打球才会和我做朋友,这一信念导致我感到Loneliness和not安全.
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询,因为我的Loneliness和not安全感持续存在并影响我的身心健康.
growth_experiences: 来访者近期因搬到新地方而开始出现not安全感与Loneliness,交友变得困难;在旧居时有稳定的朋友关系,因长期相处,共同兴趣,同校同社区而感到被接纳与舒适;搬家后尚not yet交到很多朋友,对即将到来的夏令营和秋季足球心生Anxiety与not确定.

core_beliefs: 我的真实自我not会被真正接纳

special_situations.event: Thinking that autumn soccer training and matches will begin
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not是主动选择和我做朋友,那就not是真正的友谊
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过减少参与或not去来降低Being rejected的风险,并预设他们只是队友
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are only friends with me because they want to play soccer together

special_situations.event: Considering interacting with new classmates at summer camp
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not够有趣,就not会被喜欢
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to maintain positive expectations, but worries excessively and self-evaluates before actual interactions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我可能not够有趣,do not人not会喜欢真正的我

special_situations.event: 搬到新地方后长时间not yet交到很多朋友
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果现在not能交到朋友,就说明I am not liked,将来也很难改变
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将希望寄托在not yet来活动(夏令营,足球)而非当下实际行动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我到这儿后一直not交到朋友,说明I am not liked

special_situations.event: Recalls friendships at the old residence and compares with the current environment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only friendships like in the past, with long time together and completely identical interests, count as real
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断拿现在与过去比较,忽视当前可能的积极信号
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 现在的朋友not会像过去那样真正喜欢我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be genuinely liked and accepted, and to have lasting and sincere friendships
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected或被表面性,工具性地对待,担心真实的自己not被喜欢
defense_goal: 通过保持一定距离或Avoids socializing来降低Being rejected的风险并维持安全感

object_relations.self_representation: not够有趣,容易Being rejected的新来者
object_relations.object_representation: 他人是表面接纳但not真心的同伴,只把我当队友

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing new social scenes (such as summer camp or football training) or when thinking about how to make friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人not会喜欢真正的我,只会因为活动需要才接纳我(移情:Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气犹豫,用词谨慎,常use'可能,也许'等假设性表达;当被询问具体计划时倾向强调担心他人看法并轻度回避深入细节.

manifestations: After moving to a new environment, finds it hard to make friends and worries about the authenticity of friendships
在思考社交与交友时感到not安全与Anxiety
outcomes: Declining interest in daily activities like painting and reading

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 在社交前过度自我评估(如'我可能not够有趣')
Overly concerned about whether others truly like me, cautiously initiating interactions

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: 明知家人可谈心但仍难以表达Loneliness与not安全感,将not适压在心里
在Anxiety时减少对外求助,把能量转向自我Repression

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Predicts teammates are only friends because they have to play together
揣测他人not愿真正与自己交往

exception_events.target_problem: 在搬家后面对新环境,需要结交新朋友时,来访者通常会感到Anxiety与not安全,并出现回避或Reduced socializing的倾向,导致难以建立关系.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the school and community of the old residence, the client once naturally built friendships through shared interests and long-term association, frequently doing activities together, experiencing acceptance and comfort.
exception_events.reason: 线索:not同情境与支持——与同学同校同社区,共同兴趣与熟悉的环境;长期相处带来信任与安全感,使交往更顺畅.

positive_force: Has past experience and resources of successful friendships (shared interests, long-term contact)
Positive attitude; willing to try reality testing and small-step actions
Academic performance stable; has basic life and study routines
Has potential support from parents and younger brother
能够识do not并挑战自动化思维
negative_force: 认知歪曲显著(灾难化,读心术,预测not yet来,过度概括,全或without思维,心理过滤,negate积极)
Avoidance or reduced participation in social settings
难以向家人表达Loneliness与not安全感
Tends to compare current socializing with past relationships and sink into disappointment

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance与在新环境结交朋友时的Anxiety
antecedent: Thinking about needing to make new friends
Approaching or joining social activities such as summer camp and autumn football
搬家至新环境,尚not yet建立同伴关系
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心真实的自己not被喜欢(核心Anxiety),并伴随灾难化,读心术,预测not yet来,过度概括与全或without等认知偏差.
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的拒绝与not适以暂时缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 难以建立新友谊,Loneliness与not安全感加重;对绘画与阅读的Decreased interest
